description: This file defines the TemplateHelper class within the OrangeHRM core mail plugin. The class provides functions to initialize a Twig environment and render templates using Twig templating engine, handling exceptions specific to template rendering.

classes.name: TemplateHelper
classes.description: A helper class for rendering email templates using the Twig library, encapsulating environment setup and template rendering logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TemplateHelper with a Twig environment using an ArrayLoader.

methods.name: getTwig
methods.description: Returns the Twig Environment instance used for rendering templates.

methods.name: renderTemplate
methods.description: Renders a given Twig template string with the provided context; throws a TemplateRenderException on failure.
